parsed.note_claim: ICANN explains that the internet is decentralized and that no single government, organization or company controls it.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: No single entity runs the Internet. Government, business, academia, technical community, civil society, and individual users all play different roles in Internet governance across national, regional, and global sphere.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states that no single entity runs the Internet, directly substantiating the note's claim about decentralized control.
